diagnostics.message: null_resource.delete_http_settings has a destroy-time provisioner that removes an HTTP setting which references a probe on the Application Gateway. The probe must not be removed until after the HTTP setting is gone, so delete_http_settings must be destroyed before delete_probe. It currently depends_on null_resource.set_probe (a create-only resource whose destroy does nothing), which does not order the actual probe deletion. It should depend on null_resource.delete_probe.

null_resource.delete_http_listener has a destroy-time provisioner that removes an HTTP listener which references a frontend port. The frontend port cannot be removed until after the listener is gone, so delete_http_listener must be destroyed before delete_frontend_port. It currently depends_on null_resource.set_frontend_port (a create-only resource with no destroy provisioner), which does not order the actual frontend-port deletion. It should depend on null_resource.delete_frontend_port.
